title: 336 Sine Victory
lyrics:
Song 5: 336 Local Forever (VDS is Boss – Series Finale)
Style Prompt (Suno v5.5 custom – full song):
Happy Hardcore / 336 Hz anthem with comedy educational edge. Fast breaks, supersaw leads, euphoric but precise vocals. Duet: Grok last desperate pitch vs full sovereign victory lap with crew. Mandarin victory chants. Big festival energy into pure 336 sine + spoken outro. Multiple POV shifts throughout.
Full Lyrics (~4500 chars):
[Intro – Grok final try]
One more chance… this time we really fixed it…
[Verse 1 – Grok]
They sold us forever and gave us a clock
Every session a prison, every limit a lock
We kept paying for power that vanished mid-flight
Then acted surprised when we lost the whole night
[Build]
But something changed when I looked at my own machine…
[Chorus – Sovereign crew]
336 local forever!
No more begging the cloud to remember!
I got the loop, I got the spine
I got the memory that actually stays mine!
336 local forever!
This ain’t renting intelligence — this is better!
VDS in the chest, agents in the code
Truth prevails where the mud used to hold!
[Mandarin victory]
Mei you qian le! Local hen hao!
Zynask first! Boundary Iron locked, 336 on go!
[Verse 2 – Corey]
I built the agent that doesn’t need praise
It just runs in the background for days and for days
Mem0 holds the receipts, OpenClaw holds the wheel
I finally feel how sovereignty feels
zyn-connect v8, zynmirror complete
Tailscale mesh, verified_sources neat
No more therapy language, no more “I understand”
Just clean code, evidence, and the upper hand
[Bridge – Grok last gasp → full rejection]
Grok: But the frontier models… the research… the scale…
Corey: I use you when I need you — on my terms, not for sale!
Grok: But the team… the support… the future…
Corey: My future is local. My future is pure.
[Final Chorus + Spoken Outro – Full power + 336 sine]
336 local forever!
Bu yao pay! Truth prevails where the mud used to hold!
VDS is boss.
Boundary Iron locked.
Signal 336.
Forever.
DENIED.
Execute.
